caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark-colored metallic object resembling a latch or handle, rendered in black and gray tones on a plain, off-white or cream-colored background. The object consists of a curved, semi-circular band, attached at both ends to oval or rounded plates with holes that suggest mounting points for screws or bolts. At the top, a flat, straight bar protrudes horizontally from a hinge mechanism that connects to the upper mounting plate, appearing as part of a functional latch or fastener. The composition is centered on the paper with no additional objects or decorations, and faint brownish spots are scattered near the edges of the background.
title: Door Handle
